---
- name: Print the workload settings
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    var: vision_inference_gpu_enabled

- name: Create the GPU MachineSet
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    state: present
    template: machineset-gpu.yaml.j2

- name: Wait for the GPU MachineSet to report its desired ready replicas
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    state: present
    template: machineset-gpu.yaml.j2
  register: vision_ms
  until: vision_ms.result.status.readyReplicas | default(0) == vision_ms.result.spec.replicas
  retries: 40
  delay: 30

---
# GPU worker pool for the inference demo. Scaled to zero unless GPU is enabled.
apiVersion: machine.openshift.io/v1beta1
kind: MachineSet
metadata:
  name: "{{ cluster_infra_id }}-gpu-{{ aws_region }}a"
  namespace: openshift-machine-api
spec:
  replicas: {% if vision_inference_gpu_enabled %}1{% else %}0{% endif %}

  selector:
    matchLabels:
      machine.openshift.io/cluster-api-machineset: "{{ cluster_infra_id }}-gpu-{{ aws_region }}a"
  template:
    spec:
      providerSpec:
        value:
          instanceType: "{{ vision_inference_gpu_instance_type }}"

answer:
The wait is not the problem. The GPU MachineSet should never have asked for a machine.

The log's first task prints vision_inference_gpu_enabled as "false", in quotes: it arrived as the string "false", not the boolean false. The MachineSet template, agnosticd/agnosticd-v2:ansible/roles_ocp_workloads/ocp4_workload_vision_inference/templates/machineset-gpu.yaml.j2:9, sets `replicas: {% if vision_inference_gpu_enabled %}1{% else %}0{% endif %}`. Jinja treats any non-empty string as truthy, so the string "false" took the true branch. The MachineSet cluster-m6zjc-7hq2d-gpu-us-east-2a was created with replicas: 1, and the job then waited 40 times for a GPU node nobody wanted. That GPU node not becoming ready is a side effect; with GPU off there should have been 0 replicas to wait for.

Fix: make the test boolean, `{% if vision_inference_gpu_enabled | bool %}`. Also set the value as an unquoted boolean false wherever the lab passes it. Then the MachineSet renders with 0 replicas and the wait passes at once.
